PREPARING DOCUMENTATION FOR A KOSOVO VISA
If you are not a citizen of one of the countries listed above or do not belong to one of the Special Categories then you must apply for a Kosovo visa if you wish to visit or transit through the territory of the Republic of Kosovo.
You must submit the application in person no later than three (3) months before the start of the visit to the relevant Diplomatic or Consular Mission of the Republic of Kosovo. Multi-entry visa holders can submit the application six (6) months before the valid visa expires.
The following categories are exempt from the need to obtain a visa:
Citizens of countries to which the Republic of Kosovo applies a visa regime but who have a valid biometric residence permit issued by one of the Schengen Area countries, as well as holders of a valid multi-entry Schengen visa are exempted from the need to obtain Kosovo visa for entry, transit and stay in the territory of the Republic of Kosovo. Their stay within the territory of the Republic of Kosovo is limited to 15 days.
Citizens of: EU Member States, Schengen Area Member States, Holy See, Principality of Andorra, Principality of Monaco, Republic of San Marino, Republic of Albania, Montenegro, and Republic of Serbia are allowed entry , transit and stay of up to 90 days for a period of six (6) months, with a valid biometric ID card.
Holders of diplomatic and official passports issued by the countries of the Russian Federation, the People’s Republic of China, Egypt, Indonesia, Ukraine are allowed to enter, transit and stay for up to 15 days in the territory of the Republic of Kosovo.
Holders of valid travel documents issued by the administrations of specific regions of the People’s Republic of China: Hong Kong and Macao, are exempted from the need to obtain a visa.
Holders of travel documents issued by Taiwan are exempted from the need to apply for a visa provided that they notify the diplomatic or consular mission of the Republic of Kosovo in advance, at least 2 weeks in advance.
Holders of Travel Documents (Laissez-Passers) issued by the United Nations, NATO, OSCE, Council of Europe and European Union, are exempt from visa application procedures to enter the country regardless of their nationality .
